AW YEAH, THIS IS HAPPENING
Go check this trailer made from the SSB Crusade team.
https://youtu.be/AXhGn5fuBpc

Here's a little medley I made during my exams week, and also while being commissioned to be part of the Super Smash Bros Crusade OST. It features motifs from Hotel Mario, Luigi's Mansion, Mama Luigi (From the SMW Show), and Mario Is Missing! (The SMW Castle Part).

Well... the trailer features just a small portion of the song, but this mix will be incorporated in the game! (And a little surprise guest in between)

Credits to my friend @GigaB00ts for the terrific spritework (as well the animations) for letting me be part of this wacky project. I feel wonderful for the consideration and for being asked to work on this!

Also yes, I'm planning to start making commissions!
